title: Identify: parts of a whole
text: A fraction names equal parts of a whole: 3/4 means 3 parts out of 4 equal parts. The top is the numerator, the bottom the denominator.

title: Compare: same numerator
text: With the same numerator, the fraction with the smaller denominator is bigger: 3/4 > 3/5, because fourths are larger pieces than fifths.

title: Problème : partager
text: Problème : 2 pizzas pour 3 amis, parts égales. Chacun reçoit 2/3 de pizza. Le dénominateur compte les parts, le numérateur les parts prises.

title: تحديد: أجزاء الكل
text: الكسر يسمي أجزاء متساوية من الكل: 3/4 يعني 3 أجزاء من 4 أجزاء متساوية. البسط في الأعلى والمقام في الأسفل.

title: باش تفهم les fractions
text: La fraction تقسم حاجة على أجزاء متساوية. 3/4 معناها 3 أجزاء من 4. اللي فوق numerator واللي لوطا denominator.

title: Example: half of 6
text: Half of 6 apples = 3 apples. As a fraction: 1/2 × 6 = 3.

title: Exemple : quart
text: Un quart de 12 billes = 3 billes. En fraction : 1/4 × 12 = 3.

title: Seeded error: bigger denominator
text: WRONG (seeded): «bigger denominator means bigger fraction». Truth: more pieces means smaller pieces.

title: Keywords
text: numerator = top number (parts taken). denominator = bottom number (equal parts). equivalent = same value, different numbers.

title: Visual: pizza thirds
text: A circle cut into 3 equal slices, 2 slices shaded. Alt-text ready: two thirds shaded.
